 Order

Petitioners are accused Nos. 1 and 2 in Crime No.1276/2023 registered at the Meenangadi Police Station for the offence punishable under Section 420 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code, now pending as C.C No.639/2024 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Sulthan bathery.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Sulthan bathery
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The crime is registered on the allegation that, after promising to secure admission in Italy for a doctor analytics course for the de facto complainant's son, accused collected various amounts from the de facto complainant for the period between 31.07.2023 to 17.10.2023 to the tune of Rs.1,56,500/-, accused did not secure the admission or refund the amount.

3. Learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that the dispute, which led to the incident and registration of the crime, is settled and Annexure 3 affidavit has been filed by the 2nd respondent vouching this fact.
4. Learned Counsel for the 2nd respondent also submitted that the dispute is settled and his client has no grievance against the petitioners.
5. I heard the learned Public Prosecutor also.

Having considered the gravity of the offence alleged and having perused the affidavit, the contents of which are vouched to be true and voluntary by the Counsel for the 2nd respondent, I am satisfied that no public interest is involved in this matter and the dispute has been settled amicably.
In view of the settlement arrived at between the parties, there is no possibility of the criminal proceedings ending in conviction.

As such, continuance of the proceedings will amount to an abuse of process of court and hence, in view of the legal position set out by the Honourable Supreme Court in Madan Mohan Abbot v State of Punjab [(2008) 4 SCC 582] and Gian Singh v State of Punjab and Another C. Selvakumar vs State Of Kerala on 10 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36738043/
2 [(2012) 10 SCC 303], there is no impediment in granting the relief.

Annexure 2 final report in Crime No.1276/2023 of Meenangadi Police Station and all further proceedings in C.C No.639/2024 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Sulthan bathery, as against the petitioners, are quashed.
